turn.question: Split the award: cheapest per line, but only among vendors who cleared the quality questionnaire.
turn.answer:
Based on the quality questionnaire, only **Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd.** and **Ganesh Kraft Traders** qualify, as they are the only vendors to confirm both in-house ECT/BCT testing and a valid ISO 9001 certificate.

Splitting the award by the cheapest price per line among these two eligible vendors results in the following allocation:

| Vendor | Lines Awarded | Total Value (INR) | Share |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. | 28 | 53,310,990 | 91.4% |
| Ganesh Kraft Traders | 2 | 4,991,140 | 8.6% |

**Important:** This award depends on two unconfirmed values (medium confidence) from Ganesh Kraft Traders for lines **L06** and **L23**. I strongly recommend verifying these quotes before finalizing the award.
